GRACE_DAYS = 3
OWED_LIMIT = 20


def within_grace(days_after_expiry: int) -> bool:
    return days_after_expiry <= GRACE_DAYS


# flowguard: sensor STANDING
def standing_allows(days_after_expiry: int, suspended: bool, owed: int) -> bool:
    return within_grace(days_after_expiry) and not suspended and owed <= OWED_LIMIT
